title: Maria and Her Dog
text:
Maria has a small dog. The dog is brown and very friendly. Every morning, Maria walks the dog in the park. They walk for twenty minutes.

In the afternoon, Maria reads a book at home. The book is about animals. She likes to learn new things. Reading is her favorite activity.

questions.text: Why does Maria walk her dog every morning?
options: She wants to exercise the dog and herself
She wants to buy a new dog
She is afraid of the park
She wants to find a book

questions.text: What kind of person is Maria most likely?
options: A person who likes to learn
A person who never goes outside
A person who does not like books

vocabulary.definition: the part of the day after lunch and before evening
the one you like the most
moves on foot at a slow, steady pace

paragraph_translations: María tiene un perro pequeño. El perro es marrón y muy amigable. Cada mañana, María pasea al perro en el parque. Caminan durante veinte minutos.
Por la tarde, María lee un libro en casa. El libro trata de animales. A ella le gusta aprender cosas nuevas. Leer es su actividad favorita.
